analysis_period: Dec1–March31 only,2904hours; explanatory, not global feature selection
target: target_energy_kwh; provisional13-module sum with unknown meter hierarchy/units

importance.protocol: Fit Dec-Feb, evaluate March chronological INNER holdout inside the pre-April analysis prefix. One-step forecast uses only row t-1 and known calendar at t.
importance.grouped_permutation: 20 seeded day-block shuffles; all columns in each family moved together. q05/q95 are permutation distribution, not confidence intervals
importance.individual_table: 10 block shuffles of every fitted Ridge column; correlated ties and low-R2 caveat apply
importance.limits: Low held-out R2 makes low importance inconclusive about intrinsic feature value. Correlation substitution can dilute individual scores. Group removal refits are descriptive fixed-Ridge ablations, not outer-CV selection.

PCA.standardizer_fit_period: Dec-March explanatory only; fold models fit their own scaler
PCA.excluded_exact_duplicates: activePower mean = hourly energy over1h; activePower std duplicates canonical std_power_kw
PCA.limits: PCA redundancy describes variance and does not establish predictive information; global PCA is not passed to fold models

calendar_holdout.model: Fixed calendar sine/cosine Ridge alpha100; no search

ACF_calendar.limits: Failure to reject or small ACF does not prove independence; hour/weekday effects are descriptive and must earn held-out improvement.

shuffle.method: 200 seeded target day-block permutations within calendar month, preserving24-hour order and the target marginal distribution; max over all past-feature/lag pairs controls search opportunity under this reference null
shuffle.limits: Reference diagnostic, not proof of independence or exact familywise validity under arbitrary nonstationarity. April/May excluded; same-hour features excluded.

IIDnoise.assumptions: Conditionally assume stationary five-second power with independent samples within hours and independent module innovations, with no extra predictable hourly mean changes. This is a diagnostic, not a proven data-generating process.
IIDnoise.formula: sum_m mean_hour(std_power_kw[m,h]^2)/720; one-hour energy numeric equals hourly mean kW under guide units
IIDnoise.limits: Similar variance does not prove Gaussianity, independence, synthetic generation or impossibility of forecasting. It quantifies how much apparent hourly variation could arise from averaging fast fluctuations.

phase_power.sample_type: Previous systematic descriptive sensor sample; not a full raw-row audit
phase_power.assumptions: Same circuit/time; phase voltage is line-to-neutral V, phase current A, PF percent
phase_power.interpretation: Recorded scale and conditional electrical identity need provider confirmation. Changing the guide unit from kW to W alone may not reconcile phase channels. No unit correction is applied.
phase_power.pooled_correlation_limit: Pooled correlation includes module level differences. Same-observation relationship does not give access to future voltage/current/PF, and high correlation does not certify compatible physical units.
phase_power.prior_ratio_sample_scope: Previously recorded ratio quantiles use the full16849-point Dec-Apr systematic sample; carried as a unit diagnostic only, not feature selection

recommendations: Never use same-hour energy/activePower as input to its aggregate target; shift into completed past or use supervised sequence windows.
Freeze training-prefix selected schemas before April; final3600h weight/scaler refit may reuse schema but cannot reselect with April labels.
Compare selected-zero/target-only and multivariate all-sensor candidates in outer CV. Small stable association must still earn predictive gain.
Report R²/change-prediction skill and baseline-relative error beside low percentage errors on the39k level.
Provider confirmation is needed for meter hierarchy, unit/circuit scope and actual failure labels. No unit correction applied.
statistical_limits: Same-hour large module-energy correlations are algebraic constituent relationships, not evidence of forecasting ability.
AR1-adjusted correlation p and BH are approximate under serial dependence/trend; block-max null offers a separate search-opportunity diagnostic.
No intrinsic lack of information is proved by small correlation or low importance from low-R² models.
April/May were visible in preceding project EDA; this controlled revision is not a pristine prospective experiment.
